youtube_description:
Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo.

Her last single friend got engaged today. She smiled in every photo, then came home to the same question from her aunt.

Her: Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo.

Her: Then I came home, and my aunt asked again when it's going to be my turn.

Jesus: You were happy for her and hurting for you at the same time. Both of those can be true.

Her: Everyone keeps saying the right person will come. What if he never does?

Jesus: I won't hand you a date. But I can tell you this: your life isn't on hold until someone arrives.

Her: It feels like everyone is moving forward, and I'm stuck in the same chapter.

Jesus: You're not stuck. I saw every one of your days before the first one came. None of them are wasted.

"Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be."
Psalms 139:16 (NIV)

Jesus: Your story isn't late. It's yours.
